hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a donation-funded buyback-and-burn mechanism per pool. In beforeSwap, it shields main-token sells by absorbing them at the pool's own execution price using pot funds, leaving pool price unchanged. In afterSwap, it pumps the main token on buys by spending pot funds in a capped self-call swap. Also auto-harvests and auto-compounds a hook-held LP position, splitting fees into compound, buyback, burn, and recipient shares.
